verdict.rationale: Unreal documents several scriptable control surfaces. Python editor scripting can control the editor, automate actor placement, layout and settings in levels, and build asset pipelines. The Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API can call any BlueprintCallable function on a running engine. UAT and the command line (`-run=cook`, cook/package/deploy) can trigger builds. The probe confirms these docs are fetchable by agents without credentials. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an agent actually driving the editor, and an official agent bridge (no first-party MCP; the main community MCPs are unmaintained).
